<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8F8F8"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">9:41</text>
    <line x1="325" y1="16" x2="325" y2="16" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="333" y="13" width="3" height="6" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>

    <circle cx="356" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="359" y1="18" x2="362" y2="21" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="10" width="16" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="12" width="11" height="7" rx="2" fill="#31BD00"/>
    <rect x="385" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Underlying app header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="76" x2="370" y2="76" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="20" y="61" font-family="Inter" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Community</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="58" r="18" fill="#D8E0F3"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="52" r="5" fill="#4367BC"/>
    <ellipse cx="342" cy="64" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#4367BC"/>
    <circle cx="357" cy="44" r="5" fill="#ED5555"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Search -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="112" width="350" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="134" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="139" x2="53" y2="144" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="65" y="139" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#878B90">Search conversations</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Section header -->
  <text x="20" y="193" font-family="Inter" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Latest discussions</text>
  <text x="310" y="193" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4367BC">See all</text>

  <!-- Feed card 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="208" width="348" height="113" rx="12" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="20" y="206" width="348" height="113" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="235" r="18" fill="#B8EDDC"/>
    <text x="45" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#009A67">JM</text>
    <text x="75" y="231" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Jordan Miller</text>
    <text x="75" y="250" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Today, 8:52 AM</text>
    <text x="32" y="279" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#45484C">How are you organizing your weekly goals?</text>
    <text x="32" y="301" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">12 replies</text>
    <polygon points="335,228 337,234 344,234 338,238 340,245 335,241 329,245 331,238 326,234 333,234" fill="#FFDD00"/>
    <text x="347" y="301" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">24 likes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Feed card 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="331" width="348" height="121" rx="12" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="20" y="329" width="348" height="121" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="358" r="18" fill="#D8E0F3"/>
    <text x="45" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4367BC">RK</text>
    <text x="75" y="354" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Riley Kim</text>
    <text x="75" y="373" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Yesterday, 6:14 PM</text>
    <text x="32" y="403" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#45484C">Small wins make a big difference. Sharing my</text>
    <text x="32" y="422" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#45484C">favorite focus routine with the group.</text>
    <rect x="32" y="434" width="48" height="5" rx="2" fill="#66D9B3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Feed card 3 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="21" y="462" width="348" height="112" rx="12" fill="#00000033"/>
    <rect x="20" y="460" width="348" height="112" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="489" r="18" fill="#EAF8E5"/>
    <text x="45" y="494" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#31BD00">AS</text>
    <text x="75" y="485" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Avery Singh</text>
    <text x="75" y="504" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Yesterday, 2:30 PM</text>
    <text x="32" y="535" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#45484C">What is one habit you are proud to keep?</text>
    <text x="32" y="557" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">8 replies</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation underlying -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <g transform="translate(39,780)">
      <polygon points="0,8 10,0 20,8 20,20 13,20 13,12 7,12 7,20 0,20" fill="#009A67"/>
      <text x="10" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#009A67">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(113,780)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="8" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="15" y1="13" x2="20" y2="18" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="10" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(194,780)">
      <rect x="1" y="2" width="18" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="5,16 5,21 10,16" fill="#878B90"/>
      <text x="10" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Chats</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(270,780)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="7" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="10" cy="18" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="10" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(345,780)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="3" fill="#878B90"/>
      <text x="10" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Dimmed modal backdrop -->
  <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="812" fill="#000000" opacity="0.52"/>

  <!-- Bottom sheet shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="433" width="390" height="413" rx="16" fill="#00000033"/>
  <rect x="0" y="430" width="390" height="414" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Drag handle -->
  <rect x="166" y="445" width="58" height="5" rx="3" fill="#B2B5BB"/>

  <!-- Sheet header -->
  <text x="24" y="493" font-family="Inter" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Choose an action</text>
  <circle cx="354" cy="486" r="16" fill="#F3F5F6"/>
  <line x1="348" y1="480" x2="360" y2="492" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="360" y1="480" x2="348" y2="492" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="516" x2="370" y2="516" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Contextual content -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="554" r="22" fill="#B8EDDC"/>
  <text x="48" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#009A67">JM</text>
  <text x="82" y="550" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Jordan Miller's post</text>
  <text x="82" y="570" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">How are you organizing your weekly goals?</text>

  <!-- Sheet actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="600" width="350" height="52" rx="16" fill="#009A67"/>
    <text x="195" y="632" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Share post</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="664" width="350" height="52" rx="16" fill="#F3F5F6"/>
    <text x="195" y="696" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">Save for later</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="728" width="350" height="52" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="760" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#ED5555">Report post</text>
  </g>

  <!-- permitted simple path icons -->
  <path d="M318 548 C313 542 303 547 303 555 C303 563 318 572 318 572 C318 572 333 563 333 555 C333 547 323 542 318 548" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M306 682 C306 676 310 672 316 672 L330 672 C336 672 340 676 340 682 L340 691 L333 691 L333 700 L313 700 L313 691 L306 691 Z" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M310 744 L326 744 M310 752 L326 752 M310 760 L320 760" fill="none" stroke="#ED5555" stroke-width="2"/>
</svg>
